from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,time
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
command=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id','EXHAUST-CARD-CREATION',
 '--generated-scenario-path','/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests/dev-06-silent-boss-scenario.json',
 '--combat-solver-build-dir',str(base/'build-native'),'--headless-instance','exhaust-card-creation-20261007',
 '--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(base/'evidence'),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
started=time.perf_counter()
with (base/'launcher-output.log').open('w') as log:
 result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
summary={'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-started}
(base/'native-run-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary));print((base/'launcher-output.log').read_text()[-6500:])
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
